list: Official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them; counts are PSN's tracked targets where the description names none.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work through the six roadmap stages in order and it unlocks by itself at the end, when the last trophy of Stage 6 lands.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. The 54-trophy requirement is the trophy's own description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players will earn, and there is nothing to miss here.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Mission name from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story chapters complete in order, so keep playing the main missions and this unlocks at the end of the chapter.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it pops at the end of the chapter as long as you play the story in order.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep to the main missions and it unlocks at the end of the chapter.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so it pops near the end of the story.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is the story finale, so it comes last in Stage 1 of the roadmap. One of only two gold trophies; the other is 100% completion.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableReason: Tied to the single story mission Breakfast Run: the trophy can only be earned while that mission is running.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends, so there is no way to earn it outside that mission: finish the mission's objective while you are in it. If you are already past it, look for a mission-replay option before moving on; the exact replay menu has not been verified in-game yet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Mission name from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableReason: Tied to the single story mission The Cartel Heist: the trophy can only be earned while that mission is running.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission, so expect a setup and a payoff in the same run; the trophy pops when the mission ends. If you are already past it, look for a mission-replay option; the exact replay menu has not been verified in-game yet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Mission name from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableReason: Tied to the single story mission Child's Play: the trophy can only be earned while that mission is running.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. The trophy pops when the mission ends, so it can only be earned inside that mission; finish it while you are there. If you are already past it, look for a mission-replay option; the exact replay menu has not been verified in-game yet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Mission name from the trophy description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableReason: Tied to the single story mission Headliners: the trophy can only be earned while that mission is running.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. The trophy pops when the mission ends, so it can only be earned inside that mission. If you are already past it, look for a mission-replay option; the exact replay menu has not been verified in-game yet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Mission name from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableReason: Tied to the single story mission VCIA Takedown: the trophy can only be earned while that mission is running.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The airport is the setting, so expect the mission to move through VCIA itself; the trophy pops when the mission ends. If you are already past it, look for a mission-replay option; the exact replay menu has not been verified in-game yet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Mission name from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableReason: Tied to the single story mission Operation Savage Glory: the trophy can only be earned while that mission is running.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The trophy pops when the mission ends, so it can only be earned inside that mission. If you are already past it, look for a mission-replay option; the exact replay menu has not been verified in-game yet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Mission name from the trophy description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long one: it counts everything the game tracks, so it is the last gold before the platinum. Clear the other 53 trophies first and check the in-game completion list for whatever is left; the exact checklist is the game's own, and this guide does not guess at its contents.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total. Stunts count across the whole game, so drive fast, catch air and land cleanly whenever you travel instead of saving them for a grind at the end; the counter above tracks your progress toward 250.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target 250 from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once: 9 types in all. Sample one of everything the game offers — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling and the rest — until all 9 types are tried. Do this early, in Stage 2, so you know which activities you enjoy before the longer grinds.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. The 9-type count is PSN's tracked target (PSNProfiles).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the ranges one by one and repeat any challenge until the gold score lands; the counter above tracks gold medals toward 42. Take your time: a gold on every challenge is a skill check, not a race.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. The 42-challenge count is PSN's tracked target (PSNProfiles).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location: 14 in total. Visit each race location and win once there; the counter above tracks locations won toward 14. Drone handling is its own skill, so expect a few tries at the harder courses.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. The 14-location count is PSN's tracked target (PSNProfiles).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts as long as each win is a different race, so vary the events instead of replaying one favourite; the counter above tracks distinct wins toward 20.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target 20 from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take him on at fishing; it is a one-on-one challenge, so learn the fishing rhythm first in a casual spot and then challenge him. The exact meeting spot has not been verified in-game yet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through to the end; any game counts, so choose the one you find easiest. A good early trophy for Stage 2.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand ends with this one, so keep taking his missions as they appear and the finale unlocks the trophy. Story strands like this one are why the roadmap does the story first.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Take Kenton's missions as they appear and his strand ends with this trophy. The name hints at a boat, so expect his missions to stay near the water.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand ends here, so keep taking his missions when they appear. The name suggests riding solo, so expect his missions to favour bikes.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear around the map as you explore; finish whole strands rather than single encounters, and the counter above tracks completed strands toward 8. Sweep the map in Stage 2 so no stranger is left waiting.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target 8 from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand ends with this trophy, so take his missions as they appear through the story.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand ends with this trophy, so take his missions as they appear through the story.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots. Meditation spots are spread over the map; visit each one and meditate once, and the counter above tracks spots toward 18. Fold this into the Stage 4 collectibles sweep so you cover the map once, not twice.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. The 18-spot count is PSN's tracked target (PSNProfiles).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret asks for one specific animal, so track it down and take it cleanly; the exact animal and its hunting ground have not been verified in-game yet, so check Bret's own instructions when the strand opens.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found around Leonida; a set completes when every card in it is found, and the counter above tracks completed sets toward 3. Collect as you travel in Stage 4 rather than hunting cards one by one at the end.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target 3 from the trophy description.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The counter above tracks locations toward 100; work through districts methodically so none is missed, and fold this into the Stage 4 map sweep. The exact WAiNK interaction has not been verified in-game yet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target 100 from the trophy description.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges of every kind feed this count, so the total climbs on its own while you play the activities in Stage 3; the counter above tracks completed challenges toward 50.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target 50 from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableReason: Needs your partner beside you at a 4-star wanted level: attempt it while the story keeps you paired, because later the partner may not be around.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Raise the heat to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. The missable part is the partner: attempt this while the story keeps you paired, because later your partner may not be around to help.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableReason: Needs your partner beside you for three robberies in a row: attempt it while the story keeps you paired.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Pick three shops close together, hit them in one run and keep the wanted level alive the whole time; losing the heat between shops breaks the chain. Like Hot Together, this needs your partner beside you, so attempt it while the story keeps you paired.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts, so drive anything unfamiliar you see; the counter above tracks discoveries toward 100. This climbs naturally during the Stage 4 map sweep.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target 100 from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with at least five enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus and drop all five before it ends; a busy shootout is the easiest setup. It can be retried as often as you like.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableReason: Tied to the airport sequence at VCIA: make the departure while the mission takes you through the airport.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is an airport moment: leave Vice City International by a way the airport did not schedule, while the story takes you through VCIA. Do it during that sequence, because the same setup is not waiting for you afterwards; the exact departure has not been verified in-game yet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are tanks, so this one is about tangling with armour: provoke the army's attention and survive the heat they bring. It can be retried in free roam, so there is no pressure to get it first time.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach, move quietly and leave before anyone raises the alarm; being spotted at any point breaks the attempt, but you can try again as often as you like. Pick a quiet hour in-game for the easiest run.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault robbery must end with a clean escape for it to count; the counter above tracks successful vaults toward 5. Plan the getaway before the robbery, not during it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target 5 from the trophy description.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida; stop one, take its cargo and lose the heat that follows. The name nods to the classic blitz, so a fast, hard hit and a faster getaway is the shape of it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: 52 areas. The counter above tracks areas visited toward 52; sweep the map district by district in Stage 4 and this pops when the last area is found. Combine it with the meditation spots, the WAiNK locations and the card sets so one sweep covers them all.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. The 52-area count is PSN's tracked target (PSNProfiles).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: 9 gangs. One operation per gang, so work through the gangs one by one; the exact operation spots have not been verified in-game yet, so check each gang's territory as you find it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. The 9-gang count is PSN's tracked target (PSNProfiles).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view; the trophy pops once the moment registers. A calm one after the heists of Stage 5.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableReason: A set-piece showroom moment: once the scene is over, the same setup is gone.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. This is a scripted showroom moment, so drive straight through the glass when the scene gives you the chance; once the scene is over the same setup is gone, which is why this guide flags it missable. The exact mission has not been verified in-game yet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the bowling alley, play a game and follow through on your shots; the trophy is about playing it properly, not about a perfect score. A relaxed early trophy for Stage 2.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is about a partnership moment that lands with a crowd; play through the partnered content and it pops when the moment hits. The exact trigger has not been verified in-game yet, so this guide does not guess at it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count to 500 for this one: decisions across the game add up, so play naturally and let the count climb. There is no single moment to chase; it is a tally of how you play.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. The 500 count is PSN's tracked target (PSNProfiles).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This one rewards succeeding on a second try, so a failed first attempt is part of the design, not a setback. Pick any retryable challenge and land it on the second go.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is the game's strange-encounter trophy: witness something out of the ordinary somewhere in Leonida and it pops. Keep your eyes open while exploring in Stage 5; the exact encounter has not been verified in-game yet, so this guide does not invent a location for it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a group on foot and strike with a melee weapon from the vehicle; a crowded sidewalk at low speed is the easiest setup. It can be retried as often as you like.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Laundered money counts toward the total, so keep feeding marked bills to your contacts until $250,000 is reached. This is a Stage 6 money trophy: by then you will have plenty of marked bills to move.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target $250,000 from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts toward the total, so buy cars, clothes and gear as you play and the count climbs to $100,000. It pairs naturally with Dime on the Dollar in Stage 6: launder money, then spend it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target $100,000 from the trophy description.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: 8 in all. Buy each garage as it becomes available; the last purchase pops the trophy. Garages double as storage for the vehicles Whip It Good and On the Spot need, so buy them during the Stage 4 sweep.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. The 8-property count is PSN's tracked target (PSNProfiles).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register each vehicle you want kept; the tenth registration pops the trophy. Do it alongside Whip It Good in Stage 4, since every vehicle you discover is a candidate to register.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase trophy list. Target 10 from the trophy description.
